form.label: Web Server Security Analysis & Threat Detection Dashboard
form.description: This dashboard provides real-time security monitoring, web traffic analysis, and threat detection for web server access logs. It tracks HTTP request metrics, identifies automated vulnerability scanners, detects web application attacks, monitors server error responses, and analyzes crawler activities using interactive filtering selectors.
